notes: The AugmentedAlzheimerDataset is what teams were handed; it is a transformation-based expansion of OriginalDataset.
ModerateDemented in the original has only 64 unique slices; the augmented set inflates this to 6464 (~101x) — that single class is the largest leakage risk under any random train/val split.

Neither the augmented nor the original filename convention encodes a real patient ID, so even on the original set we can only do image-level CV. True patient-level CV would require going back to the OASIS-1 source release.
